نعتل (form VIII)
# نَعْتَلِ (naʕtali) /naʕ.ta.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# نُعْتَلَ (nuʕtala) /nuʕ.ta.la/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
